title: Add LDC & Food Service task categories and restore successful build

requirements.summary: Add “LDC” and “Food Service” to the Add Task modal category dropdown while keeping all existing categories unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: In the Add Task modal (frontend/src/components/tasks/AddTaskModal.tsx), the category Select dropdown includes "LDC" and "Food Service" in addition to all existing options.
All existing category options remain present and unchanged in label and value.
Selecting "LDC" or "Food Service" allows a task to be submitted successfully.

file_operations.description: Extend the local CategoryOption union to include "LDC" and "Food Service", and add corresponding SelectItem entries to the category dropdown without altering existing options.

requirements.summary: Add “LDC” and “Food Service” to the Edit Task modal category dropdown while keeping all existing categories unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: In the Edit Task modal (frontend/src/components/tasks/EditTaskModal.tsx), the category Select dropdown includes "LDC" and "Food Service" in addition to all existing options.
All existing category options remain present and unchanged in label and value.
A task whose category is set to "LDC" or "Food Service" can be saved successfully from the Edit Task modal.

file_operations.description: Extend the local CategoryOption union to include "LDC" and "Food Service", and add corresponding SelectItem entries to the category dropdown without altering existing options.

requirements.summary: Ensure any Tasks page category filter dropdown (if present) includes “LDC” and “Food Service” while keeping all existing filter options unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: If the Tasks page has any category filter dropdown UI, it includes both "LDC" and "Food Service" options.
No existing filter options are changed or removed.

file_operations.description: Audit the Tasks page for any category filter dropdown UI; if a category filter exists, add "LDC" and "Food Service" options while preserving all existing options and behavior. If no category filter exists, keep behavior unchanged.

requirements.summary: Fix frontend build/type issues introduced by adding the new task categories and ensure Tasks UI loads without errors.
acceptanceCriteria: The frontend TypeScript build completes successfully after adding the new categories (no type errors from CategoryOption unions or Select value typing).
The Tasks page, Add Task modal, and Edit Task modal load without runtime errors and show the updated category options.

file_operations.description: Adjust CategoryOption typing and Select value/onValueChange typing (as needed) so TypeScript builds cleanly with the added "LDC" and "Food Service" options.

Adjust CategoryOption typing and task.category initialization/casting (as needed) so TypeScript builds cleanly with the added "LDC" and "Food Service" options and the modal initializes/saves without runtime errors.
